description: Source code for the AppOpsManager class in Android, managing application operation permissions, service interactions, and callbacks.

classes.name: AppOpsManager
classes.description: Manages application operation permissions, service interactions, and callback mechanisms within Android.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves the IAppOpsService instance, waiting if necessary until the service is available.

methods.name: checkOp
methods.description: Checks whether a specific operation is allowed for a given UID and package.

methods.name: checkAudioOpNoThrow
methods.description: Checks an audio operation permission without throwing exceptions.

methods.name: noteOp
methods.description: Notes an operation for a given UID and package, with optional attribution and message.

methods.name: startOpNoThrow
methods.description: Starts an operation, returning its mode, with optional attribution and message.

methods.name: finishOp
methods.description: Marks the completion of an operation for a given UID and package.

methods.name: startWatchingMode
methods.description: Starts monitoring changes to a specific operation for a package.

methods.name: stopWatchingMode
methods.description: Stops monitoring changes for a callback.

methods.name: permissionToOpCode
methods.description: Converts a permission string to its corresponding operation code.

methods.name: setCameraAudioRestriction
methods.description: Sets restrictions on camera audio usage.

methods.name: shouldCollectNotes
methods.description: Determines if notes should be collected for a specific operation, caching the result.
